description_en: Queries information about all internal-facing access applications under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 批量查询当前阿里云账号下所有内网访问应用的信息
name: ListPrivateAccessApplications

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page displayed in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the internal-facing access application. The name is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
Enabled: enabled.
Disabled: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The address of the internal-facing access application. The address is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports IPv4 addresses, CIDR blocks, domain names, and wildcard domain names
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用地址。长度为1~128个字符，支持IPv4地址、CIDR、域名、泛域名
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The IDs of internal-facing access applications. You can specify up to 100 application IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the internal-facing access tag. You can obtain the ID from the following operations:
[ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~): queries internal-facing access tags in batches.
[CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~): creates an internal-facing access tag
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问标签ID。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~)：批量查询内网访问标签。
[CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~)：创建内网访问标签
parameters.name: tag_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the internal-facing access policy. You can obtain the ID from the following operations:
[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): queries internal-facing access policies in batches.
[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): creates an internal-facing access policy
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The connector ID. You can obtain the ID from the [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~) operation
parameters.name: connector_id

parameters.help_en:
The access mode. Valid values:
app: application access. Filters applications that support application access.
browser: browser access. Filters applications that support browser access
parameters.help_zh:
访问模式。取值：
app：应用访问，筛选支持应用访问的应用。
browser：浏览器访问，筛选支持浏览器访问的应用
parameters.name: access_modes
